svg.text: BEST FOR: AGENTIC AI VALUE FUNNEL: FIRST RUN TO P&L
FORMAT LINEAGE: Jonny Tooze (#11, 141 likes, 144 comments) • Executive AI Value Realization
The Agentic AI Value Funnel: How to Cross the Pilot Ceiling From 'Work Done' to Real P&L
Most AI projects die at Stage 02 ('it ran fast in a demo') because humans still check every output. Real ROI starts at the Crossover.
THE AGENTIC CROSSOVER: HUMAN TOUCHES PER OUTCOME VS. NET VALUE DELIVERED
PILOT CEILING (80% of teams stall here)
Humans step back from the work to the gates
— — Blue: Human touches per outcome (100% -> 4%) • Vertex AI / Cloud Trace ⇄ OpenHands / LangGraph
─── Green: Net P&L value delivered (crosses Pilot Ceiling at Stage 03->04)
HOW TO BREAK THROUGH THE PILOT CEILING
Humans stop reviewing 100% of outputs only when a sandboxed
test, schema check, or citation verifier guarantees
Auto-commit the 85% of runs that pass all deterministic
gates; route only the 15% flagged anomalies to human
Stop reporting 'tokens consumed' or 'hours saved on a
survey'; track fully loaded cost per verified business
Did humans step back from doing
the work to governing the gates?
week per FTE before vs. after
show up on the income statement?
Rule: Speed without reducing Human Load hits the Pilot Ceiling. You only reach Capacity, Cost, and P&L when humans move from the work to the gates.
